name: Mrs. J. D. Garver
bio: Mrs. J. D. Garver had a new baby in March 1885, according to a story the paper attributed to her son Georgie. At the end of March 1885 she took the children to Bismarck to visit her mother, and in April she fell ill there and her husband went down to care for her.

Mrs. J. D. Garver and Mrs. Geo. Fitzgerald are both sick. In both cases it was due to too great exertion after recent illness.
